segments.environment: A compact bedroom/dormitory illuminated by bright natural daylight from a large window at the back. Along the left wall stands a clothes rack filled with hanging garments, with bags resting below. In the center against the window sits a bed where my roommate is seated, wearing a yellow patterned pajama set with their hair wrapped in a towel, holding a smartphone. Next to the bed is a small rolling table holding a bowl, a jar, and a phone stand, beside a three-tier white rolling utility cart. On the right, a wooden study desk with an attached upper hutch shelving unit is cluttered with a closed pink laptop, eyeglasses, a tissue box, a TV/AC remote, a black power hub/dock, spray bottles, and charging cables. The shelving hutch holds books, a potted plant, and a clear display case filled with collectible figurines. A purple office chair sits in front of the desk with a small white clamp-on portable fan attached to its frame. A white wall-mounted air conditioner is installed above the window.
